physics-killer-03.title: Isbeddelka isdhaafka shaqada iyo tamarta farsamada
physics-killer-03.topic: Isbeddelka isdhaafka shaqada iyo tamarta farsamada
physics-killer-03.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-03.material: Shay $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ah ayaa nasasho ka simbiriirixanaya dherer $4\,\mathrm{m}$ dusha qalooca ah ee aan marayn, wuxuu dhaafayaa qayb jiif ah oo adag oo dhererkeedu yahay $5\,\mathrm{m}$ (xoog xoqitaan joogto ah oo cabbirkiisu yahay $11\,\mathrm{N}$ shayga saaran), kadibna wuxuu fuulayaa jiirka aan marayn ee midigta. Isticmaal $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ oo iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, tamarta kulaylka $Q$ ee laga soo saaray qaybta adag iyo dhererka ugu badan ee gaadhay jiirka midigta?

Isticmaal $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ oo iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, tamarta kulaylka $Q$ ee laga soo saaray qaybta adag iyo dhererka ugu badan ee gaadhay jiirka midigta?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.explain: Tamarta farsamada ee bilowga $E_0=mgh_0=2\\cdot10\\cdot4=80\\,\\mathrm{J}$. Jiirka midig waa mid aan marayn, sidaas darteed $25=mgh$ wuxuu bixiyaa $h=\\dfrac{25}{2\\cdot10}=1.25\\,\\mathrm{m}$. Haddii la qaato in shaygu ku soo laabto $4\\,\\mathrm{m}$ waxay iska indho tirtaa xoqitaanka (doodda 2); haddii $25\\,\\mathrm{J}$ ee harsan loo qaato kulayl waxay bixisaa doodda 3; isticmaalka $mgh$ halkii $\\frac12mgh$ wuxuu bixiyaa $2.5\\,\\mathrm{m}$ (doodda 4).
